name: MongoDB MCP
description: MongoDB's official MCP server: query, inspect schemas and explain plans. Read-only as deployed; set MDB_MCP_READ_ONLY to false for writes. Set MDB_MCP_CONNECTION_STRING. MCP endpoint at /mcp. No auth of its own: anyone who reaches it gets the tools, so untick DNS-resolvable to keep it on the internal network, or put it behind a VPN.
